subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw support for callback fields that are siblings of `action.value`?
rationale: The data-loss path is source-proven, but the chosen payload format affects downstream agent command parsing and message semantics for existing Feishu button flows.

options.title: Structured additive payload
options.body: Forward `action.value` plus `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, and `options` as structured JSON only when those extra fields are present, while leaving simple button text and command behavior unchanged.

options.title: Command-text append
options.body: Append selected callback fields to the legacy command string, which is smaller but can be ambiguous for arbitrary form keys and values.

options.title: Typed action contract first
options.body: Pause the fix until maintainers define a broader typed card-action contract for Feishu and any sibling channel plugins.

recommendation.title: Structured additive payload
recommendation.body: Forward `action.value` plus `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, and `options` as structured JSON only when those extra fields are present, while leaving simple button text and command behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-line blame and recent Feishu card-action refactor history make vincentkoc the best available owner for the payload-shape decision.
